title: Null Zone
description: An area where nothing exists — no sound, no light, no sensation. Your footsteps make no noise, your breath produces no warmth, and your shadow simply stops at the boundary. The absence is so complete it becomes a presence of its own, pressing against your mind like the weight of an empty universe.

choices.label: Gather null fragments
choices.description: Collect the solidified pieces of nothingness that crumble away from the zone's edges.

choices.label: Collect the entropy residue
choices.description: Scrape the fine powder of dissolved reality from the boundary where existence ends.

choices.label: Meditate in the void
choices.description: Sit within the absolute silence and let the absence wash away pain and exhaustion.

choices.label: Retreat
choices.description: The nothingness is crawling into your thoughts. Time to leave.
